desc: The performance and features of this scale make it a great value and will be a welcome addition to your loading bench. Capacity: 750 grain (50 gram). Accuracy: 0.1 grain (0.01 gram). LCD display with blue backlight. Integrated protective cover. Carry pouch holds scale, pan and calibration weights. Auto Calibration. Measures in: grains, grams, carats and ounces. Tare Function and Counting Function. Overload protection. Auto shutoff after 60 seconds. Power: 2 AAA batteries (included). Kit contents include: The DS-750 Scale with built-in cover, powder tray, calibration weight, batteries and storage case.
